scope: Strengthened leaderboard browser regression, not RU production acceptance
checks: At least two entries with distinct ratings are mandatory
Rating, seasonal-count and profile-id API ordering is asserted
DOM row order equals API order
Own row and rank are present
No MMR jargon or raw codes
Settings opt-out hides the profile and explains the state
Second profile must have lifetime experience and seasonal placement below 20
Exact visible current-season placement text is mandatory and recorded
fixture: Fresh disposable database and role on loopback PostgreSQL; existing RU Account API and previous seed binary; after projection completed, explicit SQL established two eligible ratings and a third profile after the registration trigger. Database, role and owned processes were removed.
seed_verification_boundary: The edited seed fixture passed targeted cargo check before its counter setup was moved ahead of settlement to remove the projection race; current source passed cargo fmt --check afterwards. Its committed SHA still requires CI and a fresh executable run when the local disk guard permits linking.
limitations: Loopback synthetic fixture only; not production accounts or organic matchmaking
Browser emulation at 390 px; not a physical device
No WAN, isolated RU host, deployment or capacity acceptance
S9 documentation policy was corrected; no RU reboot was performed
